author: Zintenka
body:
Monuments: Make the monument be like a region selector. Like whether the region is a cuboid, a sphere, a point, etc.

This will add for more fun gameplay. And make it so that the monument can be any material.

Items: We really need to add into the code the option to keep certain items.

Blocks: We need a trigger or filter that modifies the drops of specific blocks. We need an option that adds renewable blocks like in OCN where in XML you can select a region that renews specified blocks. Example map: Streamline. (Not advertising)

Objectives: We need more gamemodes, I dont know the deal with this but we really need this. What happened to CTW? God knows that we need DTC.

TNT: Yes, I know that there are problems with this but we need the options in YML to manipulate its fuse, its power, whether it damages team mates, and whether it destroys blocks.

XML: The option to use XML also if that is your preferred source code. Plus, admitedly its more versatile than YML.

Any thoughts?
